title: Accept taller settings rows on macOS for 48 dp targets
context: padTapTarget on Export, Reclaim space, Delete all and Open System Settings pads the button's layout box; at desktop width each row grows from about 41 to 48 dp (Delete all moves 14 dp down). A Flutter tap area cannot extend past its row's box, so a 48 dp target needs a 48 dp row. Phone layout is unmoved. The spec had claimed nothing painted changes.
options: Accept the taller rows, 48 dp everywhere
Pad on Android only and keep Mac rows
outcome: Owner chose: accept. PR 219's rows stay as built; the spec's 'without changing what is painted' claim for 10.20 is amended.
